title: Ol' Fade Spiritual
description: Ol' Fade Spiritual — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Ex-Soldier Bubba

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Slay 20 Shadow Fade Crooners and 4 Famous Shadow Fade Crooners

Quest Reward: 5000 Gold

Return to: Ex-Soldier Bubba

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Sing that Ol' Fade Spiritual

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Slay 20 Shadow Fade Crooners and 4 Famous Shadow Fade Crooners in the branches off of Lower Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Ex-Soldier Bubba in Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Offer:

Algor has countered us reducing his Shadow Fade workforce. He has brought in some Shadow Fade Crooners to help improve the morale in the Fade Factories. The power of the Shadow Fade Crooners lies in their ability to sing songs that motivate anything within hearing distance to move out of earshot, thus effectively reducing lollygagging and tomfoolery. Keeping your ear drums from bursting and eyes from bleeding is a powerful motivator, I'll give Algor that.

Head back into the Fade Factories located in the branches off of Lower Algor's Terror-Dome and slay these Shadow Fade Crooners and Famous Shadow Fade Crooners before they have a chance to 'rally' the Workers. Then, when you have done this, return to me, Ex-Soldier Bubba, here in the Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Turn-in:

(You can't hear a word that Ex-Soldier Bubba is saying but he is nodding his head and giving you thumbs up. He then makes a motion that can only be interpreted as 'come back when your hearing returns and/or when your ears stop bleeding and you are ready to do this quest again.')

Objectives:

  • Slain Shadow Fade Crooners
  • Slain Famous Shadow Fade Crooners

Level range: 20–25
